gaps.sentence: I'm looking forward to ___ from you.
gaps.explanation: 'to' is a preposition in look forward to, so -ing follows: hearing.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the deadline by a week.
gaps.explanation: 'Agree to do something' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: She was on the verge of ___ up her job to sail around the world.
gaps.explanation: 'On the verge of' ends in a preposition, so the gerund follows.

gaps.sentence: She suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.
They accused me of ___ the rules.
I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
